headline: President Bush updated earlier executive orders to reflect the creation of the new Department of Homeland Security.
what_it_does: This order changed a number of earlier executive orders and related actions so they would line up with the newly created Department of Homeland Security. Based on the title, it appears to have updated references and assigned roles to the new department and its leader. No summary was provided, so the specific orders changed and the details are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and employees moving into or working with the Department of Homeland Security
who_it_affects.how: Earlier presidential orders were likely revised so that duties and references reflect the new department.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 23, 2003; the exact effective date is not stated in the source material.
